status: Implemented and validated on emulator and physical Xiaomi. Final 40-ms R8 release rebuilt, installed on both devices and smoke-tested on Xiaomi; emulator performance recordings use earlier 20-ms cadence. Nine recorded backward transitions remain in the selected Xiaomi live run.

implementation.renderer: Optional native animated-GIF stream in Notification.MessagingStyle; separate foreground controls notification
implementation.publicApi: Noti.startDoom({ renderer: 'live' }); legacy startDoom() defaults to flipper; stop before switching.
implementation.transport: StorageManager.openProxyFileDescriptor, native O_DIRECT, immutable frame snapshot per reader/slot until rewind
implementation.colors: Fixed RGB332 palette; color quantization always applies
implementation.failureBehavior: Continue same engine with ViewFlipper when live reader open fails; OEM animation/caching policies are not universally detectable.
implementation.cadenceRationale: 40 ms balances recorded reversals and response on the tested Xiaomi. 16 slots did not remove reversals; 50 ms produced the same reversal count as 40 ms with fewer distinct frames and slower response.

metricDefinitions.latency: Service input receipt to first recorded native game state acknowledging that input; excludes pre-service touch dispatch. One image may acknowledge multiple inputs. Video calibration/capture sampling add uncertainty.
metricDefinitions.bodyChanges: 32x18 RGB recorded game-body crop excluding markers; adjacent-sample mean absolute difference >2/255. This is scene-dependent and not display refresh rate.
metricDefinitions.distinctNativeFrames: Distinct verified native frame IDs in the recorded phase divided by phase duration. Distinct IDs can still contain identical game pixels.
metricDefinitions.limits: Short sequential pairs, not randomized sustained trials. Renderer geometry and palette differ. No claim of 50/60 distinct frames/s or universal OEM compatibility. These pairs do not isolate the causal cost of preview streaming.

conditions.state: Fresh producer process per trial; same archived APK; five-second quiet period. Live run preceded baseline; short sequential pair, not randomized.
conditions.controls: 12 isolated and 60 repeated right-turn taps; actual received intervals retained
conditions.instrumentationNote: The selected lab encodes with the then-current 30-ms native codec and changes its GIF delay byte to 40 ms before publication. Production now writes that same 40-ms byte natively. Other packet bytes, reader and engine paths are unchanged.

viewFlipper.scope: Real SystemUI recording, timed from service input receipt to the first captured image whose native rendered simulation includes that input. This excludes touch dispatch time; missed taps are counted separately. Video clock calibration and capture sampling add uncertainty.
viewFlipper.bodyMotionMethod: Actual recorded game pixels excluding marker rows; 32x18 RGB, mean absolute adjacent-sample difference >2/255. Captured changes are not a display refresh-rate measurement.

artifacts.sourceDifferenceAfterLabBuild: The current native GIF delay is 40 ms, matching the selected Xiaomi lab byte override. Earlier emulator comparisons used a 20-ms native delay and remain historical. The demo now avoids a fixed-FPS promise.

nativeGifCodec.decoder: Independent JVM ImageIO; checks all 640x400 pixels against RGB332/spatial sampling specification. Includes real Doom PPM.
nativeGifCodec.invalidArguments: null, short pixel array, invalid 7-byte and rejected 16-KiB budgets

xiaomi.limitation: Selected 40-ms recording has 9 backward frame transitions among 1093 verified game samples; zero mixed top/bottom markers and two ambiguous bottom-marker samples excluded. Baseline has zero backward transitions. Reader latch IDs remain monotonic. AOSP reference and recordings have not isolated the complete cause.
